verdict.rationale: Headless and CI automation is a fair axis for an operating system. A probe confirms an official CLI (PowerShell scripting) is documented, and one community user reports building a CI system on Windows Server 2019, so scripted, CI-style use has some support. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of headless/non-interactive operation, CI runner or pipeline integration guidance, unattended setup or automation details, and stronger independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Setting up a CI system, a user found Windows Server 2019 fast to set up
